evidence: Has the Mining label and modifies `src/interfaces/mining.h`, `src/node/block_template_manager.*`, and `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp`.
rationale: Resolves a data race where concurrent IPC worker threads access `CBlockTemplate` during `submitSolution()` while another thread reads from it. Ensuring thread-safe template access and exposing `getTotalFees()` directly improves the stability and completeness of the mining interface external Stratum v2 mining consumers rely on.
